payload.blocks: Phase 7 follow-up steps 10-13 (landed-worktree removal, p-6sd4fslxv7); other phases continue.
payload.headline: Widen heads-stable by apps/fgos/src/wiring/supervision.rs so the land door can remove a landed worktree?

parts.cause: fgos-supervision may not call fgos_checkout: the architecture manifest's door rule 'make, provision and remove a checkout' allows only checkout, worktree wiring and a few others. The clean shape is a removal port on LandPorts, supplied by the app wiring apps/fgos/src/wiring/supervision.rs, which is outside the footprint (docs/architecture-manifest.json, land.rs and its test are inside).

options.cost: One footprint line and one unit.
options.does: Supervisor adds apps/fgos/src/wiring/supervision.rs; land.rs gains a removal port, the wiring supplies it from fgos_checkout::remove, and the manifest's door rule allows that wiring file.
options.gain: Ports and adapters, one removal door, no copied checks.
options.harm: One more file in this plan.
options.label: Widen footprint by wiring/supervision.rs

options.does: Keep the follow-up out of this plan; the supervisor keeps removing worktrees by hand.
options.label: Move the removal to phase 11 or a new plan

parts.recommendation: Widen footprint by wiring/supervision.rs: it is the only place the composition root can hand the land door the existing removal.

scope.allows: Adding apps/fgos/src/wiring/supervision.rs to this plan's footprint for the removal port.
scope.forbids: Any other footprint change, and any copy of the checkout removal checks.

parts.what: The land door should remove a landed branch's clean worktree through the existing removal (fgos_checkout::remove, the code behind fgos worktree remove --delivered-to). The unit stopped without changes.
